analyst_view.overall: Danny Buijs's Fortuna Sittard are sixth and unbeaten in six league games, but they have taken only seven points from 15 at home. Henk Brugge's Telstar are near the bottom. They beat Utrecht 4-2 for their first win since the opening weekend, then went out of the KNVB Beker to Almere City in midweek. Fortuna have doubts over Rodrigo Guth and Lequincio Zeefuik, and Telstar over Gerald Alders.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Fortuna have the lowest possession in the league and play a compact, counter-attacking game. Their recent run includes three draws and a 1-0 home win, which points to tighter games than the model expects. Telstar's away record is poor, with one win in five, although Tyrone Owusu is in form with five goals in five games.

corners.text: The numbers say about 10.7 corners. Fortuna's low-possession style could hand Telstar more of the ball and some corners, but nothing in the news strongly moves the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.6 cards, a low figure for a game with Dennis Higler refereeing. We found no news on discipline or bad blood between the clubs, so we stay with the model.

shots.text: The numbers say about 28 shots. Fortuna rarely have the ball, averaging 35.7% possession, and rely on making the most of a few clear chances. That usually means fewer total shots from them. Telstar played a cup tie in midweek, which may take some edge off their pressing.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, which is high. Fortuna convert big chances well but don't fire many efforts, and Telstar have struggled to create away from home. A total just under 10 looks more realistic.
